name: codewizdevs Uptime Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted uptime monitoring software with HTTP/HTTPS, TCP, ICMP, DNS, TLS certificate and domain-expiry checks; cron heartbeats, alert channels, public status pages, and Prometheus metrics. No software subscription or published monitor quota; capacity depends on your own server.
watch_out: Requires your own Node.js 20+ server, SQLite or MySQL storage, networking and maintenance; optional Docker. SMTP, notification integrations and hosting may incur external costs. Upstream is a small project with limited adoption; review production security, backups and operational readiness independently. This is not a free hosted monitoring account.
